head_html:
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Social Media & Sentiment Analytics Report</title>
<style>
        @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 12mm;
        }
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            background-color: #f8fafc;
            color: #1e293b;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding: 10px;
        }
        .report-wrapper {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: #ffffff;
            padding: 24px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        }
        .header-section {
            border-bottom: 2px solid #0f766e;
            padding-bottom: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .brand-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            background: #ccfbf1;
            color: #0f766e;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        h1.report-title {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #0f172a;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .report-subtitle {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #475569;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .meta-box {
            text-align: right;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #64748b;
        }
        .meta-box strong {
            color: #0f172a;
        }
        
        .section-card {
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .section-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #0f766e;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
        }
        
        .kpi-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .kpi-tile {
            background: #f0fdfa;
            border: 1px solid #99f6e4;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .kpi-num {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #0f766e;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .kpi-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #475569;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .two-column-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        
        .bar-group {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .bar-info {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            color: #334155;
        }
        .bar-track {
            height: 8px;
            background: #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: #0d9488;
        }
        .bar-fill.neg { background: #ef4444; }
        .bar-fill.neu { background: #64748b; }
        .bar-fill.pos { background: #10b981; }
        
        .tag-cloud {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 0;
        }
        .tag-chip {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
            color: #0f766e;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            border-radius: 16px;
        }

        table.data-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 12px;
            margin-top: 6px;
        }
        table.data-table th {
            background: #f8fafc;
            color: #475569;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-align: left;
            padding: 8px 10px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
        }
        table.data-table td {
            padding: 8px 10px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
            color: #1e293b;
        }
        table.data-table tr:hover {
            background: #f0fdfa;
        }
        
        .post-card {
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-left: 4px solid #0f766e;
            border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
        }
        .post-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #64748b;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .post-author {
            color: #0f766e;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .post-text {
            font-size: 12.5px;
            color: #1e293b;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .sentiment-chip {
            font-size: 10px;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .sentiment-chip.negative { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }
        .sentiment-chip.neutral { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; }
        .sentiment-chip.positive { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; }
    </style>
</head>
